_comment: Outreach message templates, keyed by segment. Placeholders: {name}, {first_name}, {source_group}, {city}. Keep these conversational and always identify the sender - unsolicited bulk messaging is both against Meta's Terms and the fastest way to get an account restricted.

templates: Hi {first_name} - I saw your post in {source_group}. I work with {business_name} here in {city} and we buy properties as-is, including ones that need repairs or have been sitting vacant. If you're thinking about selling, I'd be glad to talk. If not, no worries at all.

Hi {first_name} - I'm with {business_name} in {city}. We work with owners selling as-is, vacant, or tenant-occupied properties. Happy to give you a no-obligation number on yours if that would be useful.

Hi {first_name} - I noticed you're buying in the {city} area. I'm with {business_name} and we regularly have off-market properties come across our desk. If you'd like, tell me your buy box and I'll send over anything that fits.
Hi {first_name} - saw your post in {source_group}. {business_name} works {city} off-market deals and I'm building out our buyer list. What areas and price range are you targeting?

Hi {first_name} - I'm with {business_name} in {city}. We work with wholesalers and agents on local deals and are always open to JV opportunities. If you have anything under contract right now, I'd be happy to take a look.
Hi {first_name} - saw your post in {source_group}. {business_name} is active in {city} and we partner with wholesalers and agents on dispo. Feel free to send anything you're working on my way.

follow_ups.template: Hi {first_name} - just following up on my note from last week. If the timing isn't right, no problem at all and I won't reach out again. Thanks for your time.

auto_reply._comment: Replies to people who message the Page FIRST (Meta-sanctioned, 24h window). Several variants per case so consecutive leads never see identical text. Placeholders: {first_name}, {business_name}, {city}.

seller_flow._comment: Multi-step question intake for SELL-intent conversations. Replaces the single-line auto_reply.sell templates for that intent. NEVER add a dollar figure or a specific offer anywhere here - the flow collects information, it does not negotiate. Several phrasings per stage so this fallback path doesn't sound scripted either.

greetings: Hi {first_name}, thanks for reaching out about selling! I just need a few quick details and I'll pass this straight to our acquisitions team. What's the property address?
Hi {first_name}, good to hear from you! Happy to take a look - what's the address on the property?
Hey {first_name}, thanks for the message! Let's start with the basics - what's the property address?

Hi {first_name}, thanks for reaching out about selling! It's after hours here so our team will follow up first thing in the morning - let's get a few quick details now so it's ready for them. What's the property address?
Hi {first_name}, appreciate the message! It's late on our end, but let's get a head start - what's the property address?
Hey {first_name}, thanks for reaching out! Our team's offline for the night, but I can grab a few details now - what's the address?

faq_quick_replies.title: Do I pay any fees?
faq_quick_replies.answer: No - we don't charge any fees or commissions. The offer you're given is what you get.

faq_quick_replies.title: How fast can you close?
faq_quick_replies.answer: We're flexible on timeline and can move quickly if you need to - our team will go over exact options with you directly.

faq_quick_replies.title: Do I need to make repairs?
faq_quick_replies.answer: No - we buy as-is, so there's nothing you need to fix, clean out, or prepare before talking to us.

prompts: What's the address on the property?
Got it, thanks. What condition is the property in (e.g. needs work, move-in ready, vacant)?
Thanks! What kind of shape is it in - any repairs needed, or is it move-in ready?
Appreciate that. Is it vacant, tenant-occupied, or are you living there now, and what condition is it in?
Thanks. When are you hoping to sell - right away, in the next few months, or just exploring for now?
Got it. What's your timeline looking like - ASAP, a few months out, or just gathering info for now?
Appreciate it. How soon are you looking to sell?
Understood. Mind sharing why you're looking to sell? (inherited, behind on payments, tired of being a landlord, relocating, etc.)
Thanks for that. What's prompting the sale - inherited property, relocating, tired landlord, something else?
Got it. Mind me asking what's behind the decision to sell?
Thanks for sharing that. What's the best phone number to reach you?
Appreciate it. What's a good number for our team to reach you at?
Thanks. Where's the best number to call you back on?
Last one - what's the best time of day to call you?
Almost done - what time of day usually works best for a call?
Last question - mornings, afternoons, or evenings work best for you?

seller_flow.closing_message: Thank you! Our senior management team will review this and get back to you.

comment_reply._comment: Public comment on a post containing one of these keywords gets a public reply plus a private-reply DM to start the Messenger conversation. Requires pages_manage_engagement. Never a price or an offer here either.

Thanks for commenting! Check your messages — we'd love to learn more.
